 Print AI-generated image Ahmedabad: A 69-year-old retired resident of Chandkheda and six others were allegedly cheated of Rs 15.4 lakh after a travel operator collected money for Singapore-Malaysia tour packages but failed to provide the promised services. He filed a complaint with Chandkheda police on Wednesday. According to the complaint, the elderly citizen came across a 10-day, nine-night Singapore-Malaysia tour package through a relative, who had seen the travel agency’s advertisement on Instagram on April 16. The elderly citizen and his family members visited the agency’s office at a commercial complex in Chandkheda on April 20. The operator allegedly claimed he arranged domestic and international tours, airline tickets, visas, hotel accommodation and cruise facilities. The package was offered for 14 people, including 12 adults and two children, at Rs 13.6 lakh. On April 23, the group decided to confirm the booking. The operator allegedly demanded Rs 7.5 lakh as an initial payment for airline tickets, hotel reservations and food arrangements. The complaint states that Rs 99,000 was transferred through UPI, while Rs 6.5 lakh was paid in cash. The group also submitted passports and other documents. However, the operator allegedly failed to book tickets for all members and did not arrange the Malaysia portion of the tour. Instead, he booked Singapore tickets individually over several days using his own account. When questioned about the pending arrangements, he allegedly demanded the remaining Rs 6.1 lakh.  The elderly citizen later visited the office on May 10 and May 12 but found it closed. The tour operator’s mobile was also switched off. The family subsequently made alternative arrangements through another travel agency and completed the trip on May 25. Out of Rs 4 lakh sought as a refund, the operator allegedly returned only Rs 80,500 and failed to pay the remaining Rs 3.1 lakh, the complaint states. Police said six other customers were also allegedly cheated of Rs 12.2 lakh, taking the total alleged fraud to Rs 15.4 lakh.
